title: Kar de ghaazi karam
body:
Kar de ghaazi karam
Karde ghazi karde maula tu karde ghazi karam
<<DIVIDER>>
karde maula karde ghazi tu karde maula karam.. karam
Saani nayi hai koi, ghaazi teri wafa da..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
duniya nu winj padhaya, tu yu sabak wafa da
chaukhat te teri saare..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
sar hogaye nikham
karde ghaazi karam.. karam karam..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
weeran da wastayi..(2) rakhle mera bharam
karde ghaazi karam.. karam karam..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Mangda dua te kaabe di chhat pe aawe tu
Shaane husain sab nu fir'a sun'awe tu
<<DIVIDER>>
zakir tu aap howe..(2) mimbar howe haram
karde ghaazi karam.. karam karam..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Aulaad, rizq, ghurbat, dardan de haal ne
lakkha sawaliya de, lakkha sawaal ne
<<DIVIDER>>
sab da jawab jag te..(2) ikko tera alam
karde ghaazi karam.. karam karam..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Mai naam sayyada de putra de jadd lawaa
maula hasan husain te mohsin jaga gawaa
<<DIVIDER>>
ghaazi da naam leke..(2) karnawa gal khatam
karde ghaazi karam.. karam karam..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ae qibla e wafa, aye mukhtar e do jahaan
hai oona faasla safa marwa de darmiyan
<<DIVIDER>>
jinna e door rozae..(2) sheh to tera haram
karde ghaazi karam.. karam karam..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Haider de ikhteyaar te fatwe lagawe jo
behad di apni aql nal hadda ban'awe jo
<<DIVIDER>>
karde qalam samet tu ode hattha nu qalam
karde ghaazi karam.. karam karam..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Tera maqaam jagnu aabid dasa gaya
zakir ne jinne waari abbas aakheya
<<DIVIDER>>
uth daasi maula aabid..(2) har waari rab qasam
karde ghaazi karam.. karam karam..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Akbar di aarzu we is shaan nal maraa
mai jend wele maula saawaa khatam kara
<<DIVIDER>>
meri jabeen howe..(2) howe tere qadam
karde ghaazi karam.. karam karam..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Maulaaa ghaazi..(3)
author: Mir Hassan Mir
